_meta.note: A public log of questions the Ramara Civic Forum has formally put to the Township of Ramara, with status and dated updates. Status values: awaiting | answered | follow-up | closed.

asks.subject: Request: council minutes and bylaws in bulk/machine-readable form
asks.summary: Asked the township to provide its public council records archive — minutes and bylaws — in a convenient bulk or machine-readable format, so the Hub's document search can include the full public record and residents can find what council has decided without paging through the portal one document at a time. The records are already public on CivicWeb; the request is about format and access, not about anything confidential.
